task_description.overview: Estimate P-onset by finding minimum of Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) function on a slice of the waveform.
steps: Load waveform data and define a time slice containing the event onset.
Find p_idx = argmin(aic_f) and convert to seconds: p_idx / sampling_rate.
Add slice starttime to get absolute pick time.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Given waveform samples {trace_data_path}, slice from {slice_start} to {slice_end}. Compute aic_simple on the sliced data, find the index of the minimum, convert to seconds, and return the absolute UTC pick time. Plot a figure to show the waveform, and the finally picked p arrival time. Save the pick time to {pick_time.save_name} with content {pick_time.content} and the plot to {pick_plot}.
